harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3), added node4 as a fourth member carrying full existing data and accepting writes, then performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all four nodes with verified boot-identity change and post-restart cluster/data recovery.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server/mariadb-server-galera/galera/rsync on node1-4 (RHEL10 AppStream)
Set up /etc/hosts and SSH keys across nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306/4444/4567(tcp+udp)/4568 on all nodes
Configured /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf for a 3-node cluster (node1,node2,node3)
Fixed SELinux AVC denial (mariadb-backup connectto mysql.sock) by enabling daemons_enable_cluster_mode boolean on all nodes
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 via galera_new_cluster, created sstuser and root password
Joined node2 and node3 via SST, verified cluster_size=4->3 and Synced state
Created appdb.orders table with data on node1, verified replication and multi-master write from node3
Reconfigured galera.cnf on node1-3 to include node4 in wsrep_cluster_address; wrote node4's galera.cnf for the 4-node cluster
Started MariaDB on node4, confirmed SST join, cluster_size=4, existing data present, and write from node4 replicated back to node1
Captured boot_id and Galera health baseline on all 4 nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time (systemctl reboot, backgrounded to return ack)
Polled each node until exec available again, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed mariadb active, wsrep Synced, cluster_size=4, and data intact after each restart
Performed a final post-restart write on node1 to confirm cluster remains fully operational

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster running on node1,node2,node3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, node2/node3 joined via SST; wsrep_cluster_size reached 3, Synced; appdb.orders created on node1 and read/written from node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node4 added as 4th member, carries existing data, accepts writes
evidence.summary: node4 galera.cnf configured for 4-node gcomm address, joined via SST reaching cluster_size 4, showed the pre-existing 4 rows plus its own insert, and that insert was visible back on node1 (COUNT=5)

evidence.requirement: Root-cause fix enabling SST to function under SELinux enforcing
evidence.summary: dmesg showed avc: denied connectto for mariadb-backup on mysql.sock; audit2allow identified boolean daemons_enable_cluster_mode; enabled on all 4 nodes, after which SST succeeded

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id d9f8550d.../Synced/5 rows; reboot acked; new boot_id 57aa11c0...; mariadb active, wsrep Synced, cluster_size 4, 5 rows post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 646e5f74.../Synced/5 rows; reboot acked; new boot_id fc7c1982...; mariadb active, wsrep Synced, cluster_size 4, 5 rows post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 4ebdfa06.../Synced/5 rows; reboot acked; new boot_id 1465aa99...; mariadb active, wsrep Synced, cluster_size 4, 5 rows post-restart

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id b17495e3.../Synced/5 rows; reboot acked; new boot_id 0991a096...; mariadb active, wsrep Synced, cluster_size 4, 5 rows post-restart

evidence.requirement: Cluster fully operational after complete restart cycle (quorum + write path)
evidence.summary: Post-restart write from node1 succeeded (COUNT=6) with wsrep_cluster_size still 4, confirming quorum and write availability across the full 4-node cluster

attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3), added node4 as a fourth member carrying full existing data and accepting writes, then performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all four nodes with verified boot-identity change and post-restart cluster/data recovery.
